user.title: Connect an AIVI F11 Pro
user.description: Only szxzh.fan.f11 is supported. Wake the fan and exit its Mi Home page. Enter its 12-byte BLE token, not a 16-byte bindkey or gateway token.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure F11
reconfigure.description: Enter the current BLE token. The connection is briefly released for validation.

error.invalid_address: Enter a MAC address such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.invalid_auth: BLE authentication failed. Check the 12-byte token.
error.cannot_connect: Connection failed. Wake the fan, move it near an active adapter/proxy, and exit Mi Home.
error.not_supported: The selected device is not szxzh.fan.f11.
